questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about work zones. This sign tells you to take a different route when construction changes the normal road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
Helps direct you to cities and towns ahead.
Tells you about traffic laws and regulations.
Tells you about road construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black symbols or words on a yellow background. They alert you to conditions on or near the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There are trucks hauling gravel ahead.
The highway ahead is under construction.
The highway ahead is covered with loose gravel.
The highway ahead has been sanded for icy conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is covered with loose gravel.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the road ahead has loose gravel. Drive carefully because loose gravel reduces your tire's grip on the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign is posted near intersections to remind you not to block them with your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a divided highway is starting. The road splits into two separate one-way lanes with a median between them. Stay on the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are used only to mark no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs mark school areas. Be alert for children and pedestrians. Obey crossing guards if they are present.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Driving with your headlights out of alignment because one side of your car is higher than the other.
Damaging a tire from drifting onto the shoulder.
Hydroplaning, if the shoulder has water on it.
Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the shoulder is lower than the road. If your wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not brake hard or turn sharply. This can cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you a stop sign is coming. Prepare to slow down and come to a complete stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead. Watch for trains.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows you the allowed directions from this lane at the intersection. You may turn right or go straight.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead is displaying a red light.
The traffic signal ahead is broken.
The traffic signal ahead is displaying a green light.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic signal is coming up at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows the direction traffic must flow on this street. You must drive in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: You cannot make a U-turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you a playground is nearby. Be alert for children near the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This orange construction sign warns that a person with a flag is ahead. Follow their directions carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway ahead curves only to the right.
The highway ahead turns sharply to the right.
The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
The highway ahead curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the road curves right first, then curves left. Slow down and stay alert.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a T-shaped intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it rains or gets wet. Reduce speed and be careful.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be on the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must bear either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a Y intersection ahead. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This orange construction sign warns you that a flagger is ahead. Follow the directions the flagger gives you.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
That due to upcoming roadwork, there is a detour to the right.
Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: The road ahead makes a sharp turn. Slow down as you would for a sharp turn at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign alerts you that traffic may merge from the right. Be ready to let traffic merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you a lane is ending. Be ready to allow traffic to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells you the direction you must drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the road ahead will turn sharply right and then sharply left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that your vehicle will be towed if you park in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop, whether there’s a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children crossing the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Always yield to pedestrians in crosswalks. Stay alert for pedestrians at intersections and when turning.
